enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Open dishwasher. Place bowl and spoon in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to bathroom. Look in mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone from nightstand. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace entrance. Open door. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Put on lab coat. Wash hands. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Review patient files. Attend morning meeting. Visit patient rooms. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Consult with colleagues. Write reports. Turn off computer. Remove lab coat. Leave office.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Take out cookware. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Cook food. Turn off stove. Take out plate and utensils. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Open dishwasher. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Stand up. Turn off TV. Walk to bathroom.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
